name: MOONCREST GROUP
description: MOONCREST GROUP is an independent studio building software, Minecraft projects, launchers and games.

hero.headline: Building Digital Experiences.
hero.text: MOONCREST GROUP creates software, gaming experiences, and digital projects with a focus on quality, creativity, and innovation.

about.intro: MOONCREST GROUP, formerly Jonaz Productions, is the independent studio behind MLBClient, QuickClient and PROJECT: CITY LIFE: from Minecraft clients and launchers to a free open-world game.
about.vision: Make software and games that feel finished: clear to use, honest about what they do, and built to last beyond a single release.

philosophy.title: Ship real things
philosophy.text: Features are announced when they work. Plans are labelled as plans.

philosophy.title: Respect the player
philosophy.text: No real-money shop: in MLBClient, cosmetics and emotes are unlocked with free daily credits.

philosophy.title: Own the details
philosophy.text: Every project gets its own identity, its own tools and the care to get small things right.

contact.formIntro: Questions, bug reports or business inquiries: send a message and it reaches the studio directly.

legal.privacy: This website does not use cookies, analytics or tracking. Fonts and images are served from this website. Embedded videos are only loaded from YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com) after you click play. Messages sent through the contact form are only used to answer you: depending on the host they are stored by Netlify or delivered to a private Discord channel. Please send no sensitive data.
legal.disclaimer: MLBClient and QuickClient are not official Minecraft products and are not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
